adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which does `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). This uses `Kernel#open` on an untrusted string and does not require/perform any allowlisting of scheme/host for `url` in this method. In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the importer now passes `t[:link]` directly into `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (replacing the prior behavior of just embedding the permalink), so a malicious or unexpected link could be fetched. `open-uri`/`open` will follow HTTP redirects, so even if the initial host were acceptable elsewhere, the final request could redirect off-host (SSRF). Additionally, `Kernel#open` historically treats strings beginning with `|` as a command to execute, so passing an unvalidated `t[:link]` could lead to command execution in affected Ruby configurations.
